id: number — unique identifier; the orchestrator allocates new exploded configuration IDs in a contiguous block beginning at max(existing IDs) + 1 and normalization assigns exact IDs from that block; historical IDs and reserved ranges remain valid and are never reused
model: string — clean family name, IDENTICAL across sibling configurations of the same model; never embed the differentiator in parentheses
variant: string | null — canonical snake_case key naming a comparison-distinct catalog variant sharing the same brand + model (e.g. 'standard_bearings' or 'ceramicspeed_upgrade'); compatibility options, cosmetic choices, and offer-only differences do not create variants; resolved to a localized label by the frontend variant.* i18n namespace; null/absent = model sold in a single comparison-distinct configuration
weight_grams: number | { front: number, rear: number } | null
weight_tolerance_percent: number | null - numeric percent tolerance for the published wheelset weight, e.g. 5 for +/- 5%; formerly other_specs.weight_tolerance / weight_tolerance_percent / weight_tolerance_grams / rim_weight_tolerance_percent
brake_type: string — canonical axis key: 'disc' | 'rim' | 'track' (comparable axis — filterable + sortable)

warranty.text: string | null - original warranty wording, formerly other_specs.warranty
warranty.years: number | null - explicit warranty duration in years, formerly other_specs.warranty_years; lifetime warranties keep years null

rim.externalWidth_mm: number | { front: number, rear: number } | null
rim.internalWidth_mm: number | { front: number, rear: number } | null
tire_compatibility: string - canonical tire type keys only: 'clincher' | 'tubeless' | 'tubular'; formerly other_specs.tire_type / tire_compatibility / compatible_tire_type
rim.tubeless_ready: boolean | null - derived from rim.tire_compatibility: true when it contains 'tubeless', false when the set is known and lacks 'tubeless', null when unknown

tire_width_mm.min: number | null - minimum compatible or recommended tire width in mm; formerly other_specs.min_tire_width_mm and related tire-width labels
tire_width_mm.max: number | null - maximum compatible or recommended tire width in mm; parse explicit ranges and ETRTO tire-width values only

rim.construction: string | null - free text rim material detail, layup, resin, welding, laminate, or construction technology; formerly other_specs.rim_material_name / rim_material_detail / rim_construction / rim_technology / rim_construction_technology

max_tire_pressure.psi: number | null - maximum tire pressure in psi, formerly other_specs.max_tire_pressure_psi and related source labels
max_tire_pressure.bar: number | null - maximum tire pressure in bar, converted when only psi is sourced
max_tire_pressure.note: string | null - source wording for conditional limits, such as tubeless/tubed or tire-width-specific pressure

spokes.material: string — canonical axis key: 'carbon' | 'carbon_composite' | 'steel' | 'aluminum' | 'titanium' (comparable axis — filterable + sortable)

count.front: number | null - front wheel spoke count, formerly other_specs.spoke_count_front or other_specs.spoke_count
count.rear: number | null - rear wheel spoke count, formerly other_specs.spoke_count_rear or other_specs.spoke_count

spokes.nipple: string | null - free text spoke nipple spec, formerly other_specs.nipples / spoke_nipple / spoke_nipples
spokes.type: string | null - spoke attachment/head type, e.g. 'straight-pull' or 'j-bend'; formerly other_specs.spoke_type. Do not include material or profile words here.
spokes.profile: string | null - free text spoke shape/profile, e.g. 'aero', 'round', 'flat butted', or 'elliptical'; formerly other_specs.spoke_profile. Do not include attachment/head type words here.

lacing.front: string | null - front wheel lacing, formerly other_specs.spoke_lacing_front / front_wheel_spoke_lacing or global lacing labels
lacing.rear: string | null - rear wheel lacing, formerly other_specs.spoke_lacing_rear / rear_wheel_spoke_lacing / rear_lacing or global lacing labels

freehub_options: string — canonical values only: 'Shimano HG' | 'Shimano Micro Spline' | 'SRAM XD' | 'SRAM XDR' | 'Campagnolo ED' | 'Campagnolo N3W' — see datascraping/README.md Step 3
hub.bearing_type: string | null - free text bearing type/system, formerly other_specs.bearing_type
bearing_models: string - bearing model/reference numbers, formerly other_specs.bearing_models; empty array when unknown
hub.material: string | null - free text hub body/material detail, formerly other_specs.hub_material

engagement.type: string | null - canonical engagement type: 'star-ratchet' | 'ratchet' | 'pawl' | 'other'; formerly other_specs.hub_internals / ratchet
engagement.points: number | null - points of engagement; for ratchets, tooth count such as 36T equals 36 points

certification.uci: boolean | null - UCI approval status, formerly other_specs.uci_approved or explicit certification text
certification.astm: number | null - ASTM F2043 category when sourced, formerly other_specs.astm_category
certification.ebike: boolean | null - e-bike approval status, formerly other_specs.e_bike_approved or explicit certification text

other_specs: object - genuinely unstructured, non-comparable notes ONLY (shipping, discount...). MUST NOT contain promoted warranty fields (warranty, warranty_years), promoted weight tolerance fields (weight_tolerance, weight_tolerance_percent, weight_tolerance_grams, rim_weight_tolerance_percent), promoted hub fields (bearing_type, bearing_models, hub_material), promoted hub engagement fields (points_of_engagement, ratchet_teeth, ratchet, hub_internals), promoted spoke count fields (spoke_count, spoke_count_front, spoke_count_rear, spoke_count_disc), promoted spoke detail fields (nipples, spoke_nipple, spoke_nipples, spoke_type, spoke_profile, spoke_lacing, spoke_lacing_front, spoke_lacing_rear, front_wheel_spoke_lacing, rear_wheel_spoke_lacing, lacing, rear_lacing), promoted rim material/construction fields (rim_material_name, rim_material_detail, rim_construction, rim_technology, rim_construction_technology), promoted tire pressure fields (max_tire_pressure_psi, max_tire_pressure_bar, maximum_tire_pressure, max_tire_pressure_tubeless_psi, max_tire_pressure_tubed_psi, max_tire_pressure_psi_28c, max_tire_pressure_psi_clincher, max_tire_pressure_psi_tubeless), promoted tire compatibility fields (tire_type, tire_compatibility, compatible_tire_type), promoted tire width fields (min_tire_width_mm, max_tire_width_mm, tire_width_range_mm, tire_optimized_for_mm, optimized_tire_size_mm, recommended_tire_width_mm, recommended_tire_size, recommended_tire_size_c, compatible_tire_width, compatible_tire_width_mm, suggested_tire_width_mm, tire_width_c, etrto), promoted certification fields (uci_approved, astm_category, e_bike_approved, certification), or any comparable variant data: spoke material, rim width, brake type, per-variant weight or per-variant price. Never put a price here: no price_eur, no price_usd, no price_usd_front/_rear/_wheelset - every price lives on an offer as { amount, currency }. Each comparison-distinct catalog variant is a top-level object; compatibility, cosmetic, and offer-only options remain in evidence or canonical compatibility/offer fields.

prices.amount: number | null — null = no usable price for this offer
prices.currency: string — source currency of this offer: 'EUR' | 'USD'

images: string (URL) — first element is the primary image
